## Writer identification with a CNN

<!-- Task 2: build and evaluate a CNN with writer ID as the response; overall and per-digit performance; what the measures mean in real-world terms. -->

```{r}
#| label: cnn-setup

library(keras3)
use_backend("tensorflow")
set_random_seed(67)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-split

# split by person, digit and session
set.seed(2026)
cnn_split <- handwriting$metadata %>%
  group_by(person_id, digit, session) %>%
  mutate(set = sample(rep(c("train", "val", "test"), times = c(30, 15, 5)))) %>%
  ungroup()

train_id <- cnn_split$image_id[cnn_split$set == "train"]
val_id <- cnn_split$image_id[cnn_split$set == "val"]
test_id <- cnn_split$image_id[cnn_split$set == "test"]
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-preprocess-images

# Scale pixel values to 0,1
x <- handwriting$images / 255
x_train <- x[train_id,,,,drop = FALSE]
x_val <- x[val_id, , , ,drop = FALSE]
x_test <- x[test_id,,, , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-preprocess-target


y_train <- to_categorical(handwriting$metadata$person_id[train_id] - 1, 20) #needs classes numbered from 0
y_val <- to_categorical(handwriting$metadata$person_id[val_id] - 1, 20)
y_test_original <- handwriting$metadata$person_id[test_id]
y_test <- to_categorical(y_test_original - 1, 20)

digit_test <- handwriting$metadata$digit[test_id] 
#digit_test
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-define

input <- layer_input(shape = c(28, 28, 1))
# input

# Ian's model structure taken from lecture slides
output <- input %>%
  layer_conv_2d(filters = 16, kernel_size = c(3,3)) %>%
  layer_activation('relu') %>%
  layer_dropout(rate = 0.20) %>%
  layer_conv_2d(filters = 16, kernel_size = c(3,3), activation = "relu") %>%
  layer_max_pooling_2d(pool_size = c(2, 2)) %>%
  layer_flatten() %>%
  layer_dense(units = 20, activation = 'softmax')

model <- keras_model(inputs = input, outputs = output)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-summary

model
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-compile

model %>% compile(
  loss = 'categorical_crossentropy',
  optimizer = optimizer_adam(learning_rate = 0.01),
  metrics = c('accuracy'),
)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-fit

history <- model %>% fit(
  x_train, y_train,
  epochs = 40, batch_size = 8192,
  validation_data = list(x_val, y_val), shuffle = TRUE,
  verbose = 0,
  callbacks = list(
    callback_early_stopping(monitor = "val_loss", patience = 10,
                            restore_best_weights = TRUE)
  )
)

```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-history

plot(history)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-evaluate

model %>% evaluate(x_test, y_test)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-predict

y_test_hat <- model %>% predict(x_test) %>% op_argmax(axis = 2) %>% as.numeric()
# y_test_hat
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-confusion

table(y_test_original, y_test_hat)
```

```{r}
#| label: cnn-by-digit

tibble(digit = digit_test, correct = y_test_original == y_test_hat) %>%
  group_by(digit) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), accuracy = mean(correct))
```
